Definition: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
BiblicalUsage: 1) to trust; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to trust, trust in; 1a2) to have confidence, be confident; 1a3) to be bold; 1a4) to be secure; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to cause to trust, make secure; 2) (TWOT) to feel safe, be careless
